title: The Old Genie
overview: Moscow schoolboy Volodya accidentally fishes out of the Moscow River a mysterious lamp, from which the genie Khottabych appears. He promises to fulfill any of his wishes, but each of them turns into unexpected consequences. Magic multiplies, rather than solves Volodya's problems. Nevertheless, the schoolboy is imbued with the genie's problems and, as a result, finds himself in the past, where Khottabych's daughter marries an unloved man. Trying to destroy this marriage and free Khottabych, Volodya and his friends go to an ancient Eastern wedding.

title: Brujo
overview: Plot unknown.

title: All Legs
overview: On their annual summer camp, a group of Boy Scouts are attacked in the woods by a creature with legs for arms.

title: Desert Moons
overview: Tessel moves through Berlin, searching.

title: Rocky Wake
overview: Elise, long estranged from her mother Megan, visits her as she lies on her deathbed. Her mother recounts a life-changing moment from the early 80s, her father’s devastating diagnosis and a serial killer stalking the town. Elise reconstructs her mother’s memories, drawing them closer as the night unfolds.

title: Vampyr
overview: A struggling author, who is obsessed with Edvard Munch, finds himself on the verge of madness when he's dragged into a dangerous murder mystery that uncovers a horrifying truth about the world-famous painter, and potentially rewrites history as we know it.

title: The Unicorn That Said No
overview: In the Forest of Hearts, a little, sweepity, swoopity, swappity, sweet unicorn is born. But even though everyone is very lilacly-loving to it and constantly feeds it with sweet lucky clover, the little critter does not behave unicorn-like at all. It just keeps saying no, so soon its family just calls it uNOcorn. One day, the uNOcorn breaks out of its cotton candy world and sets off to NOWHERE. On the way, he unexpectedly meets a raccoon that refuses to listen (HUHcoon), a watchdog that doesn‘t seem to care about anything (SOWHATchdog), and princess that always talks back (PrinceYES). The four of them make a pretty good team. Because even being stubborn is much more fun together.

title: Bleeders
overview: A drug deal with a vampire goes horribly wrong.

title: All the Lovers in the Night
overview: Freelance proofreader Fuyuko's carefully ordered life in solitude begins to transform after meeting Mitsutsuka, a quiet high school physics teacher.

title: Enervo
overview: On the one-year death anniversary of her mother, Mikey is forced to face her inner demons while paralyzed as her guilt manifests itself into physical form.

title: Death Always Craves
overview: The story follows a young pregnant woman who, upon visiting her ailing mother, finds herself trapped in a whirlwind of supernatural events and dark secrets that connect her to the mysterious past of the old residence.

title: Pendulum
overview: Young couple Patrick and Abigail journey to a new-age retreat in New Mexico, drawn by the possibility of healing after a traumatic event. Patrick is willing to do anything to help his wife but becomes distrustful of the retreat’s enigmatic leader even as Abigail falls under her spell. As paranoia builds, the couple must determine if the group’s unconventional spiritual practices offer genuine healing or mask a terrifying truth that threatens to consume them both.

title: The Wizard of the Emerald City, Part II
overview: The heroes journey to the Purple Country and confront the witch Bastinda.

title: Catechesis
overview: An education in the faith.

title: Vedaat Marathe Veer Daudale Saat
overview: It shows the inspirational story of the extraordinary bravery of seven Maratha warriors of Maratha Empire to achieve dream of Swaraj in 1674.

title: Don't Save The Date
overview: Meshi, a barista from Tel Aviv who likes to mess around, has a great habit of avoiding responsibility. He promises his best friend to organize the most luxurious bachelor party ever - and then completely forgets about it. When the day of the party arrives and the obsessive bride hands off the groom to him with very detailed operating instructions, Meshi realizes the severity of the problem he set himself into. With no other choice, he starts planning the event on the go. Soon enough, things get out of control. Between nonstop moments of insanity and some moments of simple truth, Meshi discovers that he might not have been "on it" as he believed.

title: The Dream of a Ridiculous Man
overview: A man driven by isolation and a nihilistic view decides to end his own life, but on the eve of his fateful decision, a chance encounter with a lone woman leads him to a fantastical dream that challenges his own ideologies.

title: Ondin
overview: An Avantgarde Portrait Of Classical Musician Puschan Mousavi Malvani.

title: The Inmate
overview: About an inmate who fears the outside world.

title: My Joint with John
overview: A once-hopeful screenwriter on the brink of burnout shares one last joint with his stoner best friend.

title: MIKE.
overview: Based on real events, a young man is consumed by buried trauma and destructive impulses. As family matters pull him into a chaotic downward spiral, he is forced to confront his past before he loses himself forever.

title: What We Owe to Each Other
overview: Plot unknown.

title: The Curse of the Silver Chain
overview: A silver chain that appears for centuries made by warlocks in the 15th century.

title: Get to That Place
overview: A group of kids navigate their lives and interpersonal relationships while a rumor about the end of the world spreads around town.

title: I Know Something You Don't
overview: Joel Lawson, an online self-proclaimed journalist with stalker tendencies, gets the opportunity to interview on the rise actress Rachel Knight, the latest target of his voyeuristic desire.

title: Two Christmases, One Lesya
overview: As Christmas approaches, Lesya, a conveniance store clerk from Bila Cerkva, grows more and more frustrated as debts begin to swamp her and her parents once again start with a daily dosage of bickering. However, as the holiday season approaches, she gains the abbility to travel between parallel worlds in her sleep. Whilst in our reality she might be a nobody, on the other side she's a glamorous and wealthy TV star. Clock is ticking and Lesya must decide wheater she's going to stay in our world or leave it for the glamour of the other side.

title: ES grünt SO grün WO Ehmken's Blüten blühn
overview: An Oneiric, Essayistic »Memory Poem« About The "Wildkräuterhotel Ehmkendorf" and the circumjacent "Urstromtal".

title: 'The Wokinator'
overview: Working title. Sci-Fi action film by Kirsten Paltzat.

title: The Beginning of Her Reign
overview: A successful businessman longs for female domination. His secretary becomes his partner in a daring journey of love, power, and self-discovery, challenging societal norms and personal boundaries.

title: Overdrive
overview: A year after his refusal to pull off the track cost his team the championship, an eighteen year old Bahraini karting driver argues his way back into a seat for a twelve hour endurance race, and finds that the only way to win it is the one thing he has never done.

title: The Architecture of Solitude
overview: Tracing the hidden life of interiors.

title: Scrying Session #2
overview: A Triptychal Mixed-Media-Rhizome Intertwining The Notions Of "Scrying", "Vision Quest", "LoFi Hauntology" & "Butoh".

title: The Suffering Tenants
overview: The enemy, the lover and the brother of a missing landlady all become entangled in this Hitchcockian chamber play, set in the mid-70s.

title: The Heavy End
overview: Following the sudden passing of his wife, a devout church warden comes to question his lifelong devotion to the cause.

title: Attack On Allford 3: Too Cruel For School
overview: Rio barely survives death, only to wake up in a world cheering his demise. Meanwhile, Jacob is snatched and thrown into a brutal 24-hour countdown: eliminate Rio or get hunted. With the end within reach, who will survive the final stand?

title: Mindshare: The Download
overview: After joining Mindshare, Evan begins experiencing vivid flashes of a life he doesn't remember. The company insists these are normal side effects of neural acclimation, but Evan soon discovers that his memories have been edited, replaced, and repurposed. As he uncovers the identity of the man whose memories he carries, Evan realizes he is living a borrowed life, and Mindshare will do anything to keep him from reclaiming his own.

title: Starlight & You
overview: Lily and Peter is a modern romantic drama about timing, connection, and love tested by real life. When a quiet online connection pulls two people together, distance, delay, and unexpected loss challenge what they're building. As they choose to show up for one another, their bond deepens into a love shaped by family values, resilience, and emotional truth. Warm, intimate, and universally relatable, Lily and Peter is a character-driven love story made for audiences who believe the strongest romances are earned.

title: Angel
overview: When a sex worker is consumed by the life of drugs and partying, accidentally overdosing, she embarks on a journey to better her life.

title: PEBBLES
overview: A tourist from abroad and a fossil hunter team up to discover the hidden gems of the Jurassic Coast in Dorset, England.

title: FILIZ
overview: Filiz is communicating with a voice coming from an old sound recorder. Meanwhile she is causing musical trouble with her friends, taking care of a grandmother and trying not to be discovered in her hideaway underneath the city.

title: Dead Soldier II
overview: Reese Cadler has moved to a country-side town after being attacked by The Soldier, a gas mask wearing killer  whom, unfathomably so, has managed to survived multiple gunshot wounds and evade police. One year later, he’s come back, and the war is not yet over.

title: Mr. Penguin: The Movie
overview: When unexplained events begin to occur, a hidden presence reveals itself. Silent, watchful, and growing closer—Mr. Penguin is no longer just a mystery.

title: When the Night Shines
overview: A young group of friends goes on a cozy summer trip, but, everything turns dark, quite literally…

title: HOW TO MAKE TURKISH EGGS
overview: A young woman cooks in her family kitchen. Through an off-screen exchange with her mother, generational tensions around womanhood, faith, and expectation quietly surface.

title: OOPART
overview: In 2007, a series of recovered recordings documents the final encounters with beings that could still be distinguished from us.

title: The Parallel World: The rift
overview: After a boy enters a dangerous parallel world, he begins to realize that a powerful sorcerer in this realm threatens to destroy reality itself—and that the sorcerer will stop at nothing to achieve this, killing anyone who stands in his way.

title: Mouthwashing : The Film
overview: The Indian Film Adaptation Of The Bone-Chilling Video Game - Mouthwashing

title: Zac Power
overview: Zac Power’s position as the top teenage spy is compromised after a brilliant new agent arrives. When his recklessness allows an ostentatious supervillain to steal a high-tech weapon, Zac is forced to confront his own flaws and team up with his rival.

title: Heysel 85
overview: When 39 people are killed prior to the European Cup at the Brussels Heysel stadium in 1985, the mayor's daughter and an Italian journalist are torn between their professional assignments, family, and human nature.

title: Gone Part Three
overview: The finale in the series. How will it end?

title: The Liberation
overview: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

title: Sins of Kujo
overview: Kujo (Yuya Yagira) continues to live under a tent on a building rooftop, taking on anyone who seeks his help, including those from the criminal underworld.  Although they have separate ways, Kujo's former partner, Karasuma (Hokuto Matsumura), is drawn back into his life as the two become caught between a violent underworld conflict and an escalating police and prosecutorial crackdown.

title: Mahakāli
overview: Upcoming Female Superhero PVCU Film.  An epic journey of empowerment, faith, and resilience, inspired by the fierce and compassionate nature of the Goddess Kali. The film will explore not only her divine power but also touch upon themes of discrimination, inner strength, and the reclaiming of one’s identity in a world that often overlooks the value of darker skin.

title: You’ve Got Mail
overview: A mail deliverer is captured by Irish-American gangsters to launder money and drugs for them in this black comedy thriller.

title: Citric Acid
overview: A young artist is stalked via the internet by a mysterious online celebrity who harshly criticizes their artwork.

title: Sambarala Yetti Gattu
overview: In a land ruled by a ruthless tyrant, a young man embarks on a dangerous quest to dismantle the warlords empire and free his people from oppression.

title: Lappen: A Tragedy.
overview: Lappen is an ambitious actress — and a washcloth in a world dominated by humans. Despite her acting training, she fails to make a breakthrough at a small theater. Her appearance and the patriarchal environment confine her to minor roles. At the lowest point of her career, she decides to try her luck in the film industry.

title: Children of Blood and Bone
overview: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

title: Cancel 2
overview: When the entire social media faces an unprecedented wave of "cancel culture," Santtu and Weksi are recruited to uncover the story behind the events, leading the duo on a fast-paced adventure.

title: The Beekeeper 2
overview: Now a wanted man, former government assassin Adam Clay continues his vendetta against those who wronged him.

title: Bearhunting
overview: While Germany in 1834 is simmering in every corner, the resistance led by Georg Büchner is working on the revolution. Heinrich Furrer secretly prints Büchner‘s revolutionary leaflet “Der Hessische Landbote“ in his brother Gustav‘s printing House, thus supporting the revolutionaries. Heinrich loves Minna. She wants to go to America!… and he‘s supposed to come with her. Everything could be so simple if Heinrich weren‘t living with Agnes, a former prostitute, if he had the necessary money and Minna wasn‘t married to his brother Gustav.

title: BRB: First Blood
overview: Once upon a time in 2209 A.D.

title: Kumari: The Lost Continent
overview: Nila, an energetic teen, sets out to find the legendary lost continent of Kumari Kandam, only to discover a hidden land high in the clouds. As she explores, she uncovers a mystery that ties this sky continent to the legend of Kumari Kandam in ways she never expected.

title: Renoir & Love
overview: Pierre-Auguste Renoir is one of the world’s favourite artists, a founding member of the Impressionist movement and a constantly evolving artist. With exclusive access to the National Gallery’s new exciting show of the same name (3 October 2026 – 31 January 2027), Exhibition on Screen will bring Renoir’s world class works to cinema audiences. Be transported back to a Parisian summer of love through the eyes of a true visionary. An unmissable opportunity to fall in love with Renoir this winter.

title: Milo
overview: After leaving prison, Alice takes a job as a waitress in a small cafeteria that sits next to an auto repair garage. She befriends a young man named Milo, who works at the garage, and slowly it becomes apparent that Alice's real reason for getting close to him is deeply personal: Milo is her son.

title: Mu Yi and the Handsome General
overview: Mu Yi, 14, lives on a Chinese secluded mountain, forbidden to men. With her two friends, she encounters an opera troupe renowned for The Handsome General play. As she invites them to perform in her village, an angry Spirit awakens. To restore balance, Mu Yi embarks on a life-changing journey through old China, uncovering the secrets of love, courage and self-made destiny.

title: Tangles
overview: When Alzheimer's disease begins to strip away her mother's vibrant personality, a headstrong young woman is forced to return to her oddball family in the conservative small town she recently fled in order to care for her. She quickly realizes she must accept the cruel and warped reality of the disease, and the imperfect beauty of her family, in order to become the daughter they need.

title: When the Night Falls
overview: Follows the incredible story of a 1942 effort to to save over 100 Jewish children from a deportation camp just outside of Lyon.

title: In the Absence of Choice
overview: When a loyal enforcer of a vampire order begins to remember the night his childhood ended, the truth waiting in the dark threatens to consume what’s left of him.

title: Animal Friends
overview: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove.

title: Snow Eight
overview: Mark, a 12-year-old sloppy teenager from a rich family, is sent by his mother from Moscow to Kamchatka to live with his harsh father, Kai, after another scandalous offense. Far from his usual life, the Internet and school friends, the boy finds himself in the world of dog sled racing. Working with animals — the snow eight charming husky dogs — becomes a real challenge for him. Gradually, Mark finds friends — Anya and Petka — and discovers the power of the team, where trust and support are important. And mom and dad have to change their views on raising a child and, most importantly, look at each other with completely new eyes.

title: Expedice Galejník
overview: The story of four dads, their six children and a bachelor takes the audience on a summer hiking trip to the mountains. The Galejník expedition has two basic rules: Survive! And no women. From the very start, however, nothing goes to plan…

title: The Education of Jane Cumming
overview: Edinburgh, 1810. Two female teachers find themselves at the centre of a scandal when one of their pupils accuses them of having a love affair. A drama about prejudice, survival and the courage to stand up for the truth.

title: Death Has No Master
overview: Caro travels to Venezuela to sell her late father’s cacao plantation, only to find the family mansion occupied by its former staff, who are determined to remain at all costs. As Caro takes justice into her own hands to claim the inheritance she believes is hers, she sets off a struggle that unearths the violence buried in the land and its memory.

title: Komplizinnen - Vernunft ist keine Lösung
overview: Amidst sweating attacks, sex escapades, existential fears and the unsuccessful fight against the signs of the times, four women search for happiness and find themselves.

title: The Pride of Bharat: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj
Bergman
overview: An upcoming surrealist film based in Paris regarding a mysterious man.

title: House Spirit
overview: Ivanka, an owner of a small Kyiv caffee, faces debt and decides to sell her only piece of inheritance—her grandmother's house in a small town in the Poltavschynna region. Soon, the girl discovers that the house is inhabited by a house spirit named Roman, a young, seductive handsome man who will do anything to save the house from being sold.

title: Air Bud Returns
overview: 12-year-old Jacob is an aspiring basketball player coping with the recent loss of his father. After he and his mother move to his dad’s childhood home in Fernfield, Jacob discovers a VHS tape of his old man playing basketball on the same court as a hoops-shooting golden retriever. Soon, Jacob begins his own adventure with a neglected golden retriever that he names Buddy.

title: The Third Parent
overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

title: Dante
overview: Responding to an emergency call, a young paramedic unwittingly finds himself thrust into the middle of a war between two crime lords, triggering an escalating series of gruesome twists and turns over the course of one crazy night.

title: A morte nos teus ollos
overview: In 1994 Vigo, two disgraced police officers team up to rob a local businessman. One is a suspended father on the brink, the other a volatile high-stakes gambler. As their scheme unfolds, their fragile alliance begins to crack.

title: 5 More Minutes
overview: An on-the-rocks couple retreat to a secluded countryside home for the weekend in an effort to repair their marriage. They're greeted by the singular head of the real estate agency who shows them around the place and hands over the keys. Just before he leaves, however, the entire world slips into a time loop, and the last five minutes begin to repeat endlessly.

title: The Metropolitan Opera 2026/27: La Fanciulla del West
Land Uncharted
overview: In the 1930s a trio of adventurers set off to find an uncharted land.

title: The Man I Love
overview: In late 1980s New York, a theater artist living with AIDS takes on one possibly last great role.

title: Lice
overview: A gruesome death. A sealed-off high school. Something crawling beneath the skin. When a student’s terrifying breakdown shocks a classroom, an almost invisible parasite spreads through the halls, instantly twisting teens into maniacs. Locked inside with no escape, students and staff spiral into violence and hysteria. Amid the chaos, Principal Van struggles to maintain control, drowning his anxiety in alcohol before losing his grip on reality – and his head. Burned-out science teacher Mr. Shanker steps up as the only adult trying to make sense of the madness, uncovering traces of a government experiment gone wrong. Outside the quarantined halls, Detective Sikorski races to contain the outbreak before it consumes the entire town. The real horror isn’t what’s under your skin – it’s what it makes you do.

title: Blaise
overview: The Sauvage family is desperate to be loved. Carole knows her employees hate her and is determined to win them over at any cost. Jacques has never worked a day in his life and doesn’t feel respected. As for their 16 y.o introverted son Blaise, who lacks a personality, he always goes along with everyone and agrees to everything… So much so that when he meets this girl, Josephine, he politely embarks on a revolutionary, violent, and completely impromptu crusade.

title: Un jeu dangereux
overview: In a summer villa, a couple married for twenty years invites an enigmatic young woman. Amidst desire, jealousy, and unspoken words, a dangerous game unfolds where each plays their part. Their children, watching from afar, anxiously observe: who is playing with whom? Is their mother in danger?

title: Man's Skin
overview: In 1480, or thereabouts, as Princess Blanche prepares to unite with the handsome prince of a neighboring kingdom, her father decides to marry her to Melchior, his coarse army commander whom she barely knows. Devastated, she asks for the help of her godmother, who reveals that she is in possession of a mysterious “skin” which, once worn, will allow Blanche to become a man and thus get to know her fiancé incognito.

title: A Girl Unknown
overview: A Chinese girl is passed between three families from the age of 6 to 18, receiving each time a new name and identity. As she searches for belonging and the possibility of love, she has to navigate between the weight of her past and the uncertainty of her future, until she finds her own way.

title: La Gradiva
overview: A small group of French high school students goes on a school trip to Pompeii to discover its ruins and the bodies petrified by Vesuvius in 79 CE. It is in this ghost town that they are suddenly overcome by a dizzying sensation. One after another, James, Toni, Suzanne, and their Latin teacher, Mme Mercier, allow themselves to be engulfed by desire, anger, and despair—until they surrender to it completely and lose everything.

title: The Rescue
overview: A modern day western in which a rodeo cowboy's skills are put to the test outside the arena.

title: ZOMA
overview: A grieving mother seeks answers over her son’s death, which she believes may be linked to AI therapy app ZOMA. Defying her boss, an ambitious young attorney takes on the case, and soon finds herself battling not only the tech firm NuvoMind and its formidable legal team but also an algorithm that seems to understand the human psyche better than humans themselves.

title: Karoshi
overview: Described as a corporate thriller with a samurai twist. Set in a Japanese-influenced New York City and features a revenge element. Plot TBA.

title: Dead Mountaineer's Hotel
overview: Police inspector Peter Glebski arrives at a small mountain hotel, "At the Dead Mountaineer's", after receiving an anonymous letter - the letter warns that a murder will be committed in the hotel. An avalanche that occurs in the evening blocks the only exit from the gorge, and at night Glebski discovers the body of one of the guests...

title: Strawberries
overview: Hasna leaves her native Morocco to work as a seasonal laborer picking strawberries in Huelva, Andalucia.

title: Neanderthal
overview: Fedor is a famous MMA champion who lost not only his reputation in the sports world, but also his family due to uncontrolled aggression. To change, he decides to go to Altai, but is accidentally transported to the primitive world 10,000 years before BC. The local aborigines mistake him for a warrior who will help them defeat their sworn enemy. Fedor understands that he is a weakling among the aborigines, so in the struggle it is necessary to use not force, but cunning and the ability to negotiate. Together with the shaman's daughter Reba, he goes to his main goal – to return home.

title: Inside That House
overview: After a number of strange disappearances have been reported in the area, Andrew and Jason, two brothers who received a drone for graduation, decide to film around their town to learn more about them, but then become distracted by a new girl in school who lives nearby. The two boys devise a plan to sneak their drone through an open window of her home, only to discover a terrible, dark secret.

title: Drag
overview: A routine robbery at a rural house turns into a nightmare for two amateur burglars when one of them throws their back out. Things spiral out of control as they try to make it out before the homeowner returns.

title: Kaiji: Life Revenge Game
overview: Burdened by debt, Kaiji Itou is forced into a series of high-stakes gambling games where he must risk everything to survive and take control of his future.

title: Bygd på kjærlighet
overview: Upcomming movie based on Norways most sold frozen pizza. Grandiosa

title: Maudits Français
overview: The comedy explores the clash of cultures between a French woman and a Quebecer, highlighting the complexities of language and cultural differences between families.

title: The Stars That Fade
overview: After a tragic loss, a writer seeks comfort in publishing an anthology of horror stories. As his mental state deteriorates, his imagination blends with reality and tragedy seems imminent.
